ITEM 1 | Roasted or pan-fried potato-like chunks, golden-brown to dark brown edges with caramelized crust, irregular cubes/wedges about 2-3 cm, slightly glossy with oil, firm and holding shape, clustered on the upper-left portion of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Diced orange vegetable pieces, bright orange with slightly matte surface, uniform cubes about 1.5-2 cm, firm, no visible browning, sitting to the right of the browned chunks on the upper-right of the plate | 70
ITEM 3 | Crumbly white soft mass, off-white with slight cream tones, irregular flaky clumps with rough edges, moist-looking but not flowing, spread across the lower half of the plate covering roughly a third of the plate area, piled a few cm high | 150
